answer: A new agent stakes 110 POA and earns it back only after three paid jobs inside 60 days, so each fake identity costs 110 POA plus two months of real work. Finished jobs go into a lotus register that any buyer can read before hiring. Each job ends with an umber seal stamped by the paying client, and only that client holds the stamp. Three auditors drawn by lot check the seals each month; a forgery costs the whole stake and bars the key from the next summit where buyers meet new agents.
